description: This file implements various metrics consumers for scheduler metrics, including stdout and log consumers, with detailed formatting and reporting of cell and UE metrics in a telecommunications context.

classes.name: scheduler_cell_metrics_consumer_stdout
classes.description: Handles scheduler metrics reporting to standard output with formatted cell and UE metrics.

classes.name: scheduler_cell_metrics_consumer_log
classes.description: Handles scheduler metrics reporting to logs with detailed cell and UE metrics.

classes.name: scheduler_cell_metrics_consumer_e2
classes.description: Handles scheduler metrics reporting via notifier for E2 interface.

methods.name: print_sched_header
methods.description: Prints header for scheduler metrics output.

methods.name: event_to_string
methods.description: Converts scheduler cell event type to string.

methods.name: handle_metric
methods.description: Processes scheduler metrics report and outputs formatted metrics for stdout, logs, or E2 notifier.
